items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was Kedori in the band then? [INTERVIEWEE] It was Ory and Oliver's jazz band. I was leading the band.

ctx.x: He had a better job than Pete Lala's job, this guy. What about that one?
You played violin there with Oliver. Was Kedori in the band then?
It was Ory and Oliver's jazz band. I was leading the band.
